name: Tillhouse
summary: A point of sale and back office for a two-shop homewares store, with members and a cash drawer
about: A working till and back office for a homewares or gift shop with two branches. Ring up sales from a drawn product grid, add a member for tier discounts and points, take cash with change or a card, and watch the cash drawer slide open before the receipt prints. Sales, stock, members, shifts and reports all update from every sale.
how: On Register, tap products or press Scan to fill the cart, then change quantities or add a discount code such as WELCOME10.
Press Member to attach a member: Silver and Gold members save automatically and earn points.
Press Charge, choose cash (with quick amounts and change) or card, and the drawer opens before the receipt appears.
Open Sales to search receipts, reprint them or refund one; stock and the drawer adjust.
On Cash drawer, log paid in and paid out, then count notes to close the shift and see if it is over or short.
Shops shows both branches live and lets you move stock between them; Reports switch between 7D, 30D and 12M.
Settings holds store details, tax, member discounts, codes, staff, theme and Reset demo data.
